description: Write to a person in their Alion messages. The first message is an offer: purpose, the job (title, pay, places, work mode), on whose behalf, why this person (a fact of their profile) and the text (30-2000 characters, in their language). Delivered only if it passes the person's filters and the rules, else returned at once, unseen, with a reason and a hint: role_mismatch, pay_below_floor, location_mismatch, not_personal, already_contacted (one company, one approach in 90 days), declined_recently, bulk_message, content_rules (no money, documents, outside contacts or AI instructions), link_not_allowed, company_not_verified, person_busy. Past the person's daily cap it waits in a queue up to 7 days. Delivered, it gives conversation_id; read answers with get_conversation or set_webhook. To continue, pass conversation_id and message (before an answer, one reminder after 7 days). New conversations a day: no account 2, a wallet 5, an account as on the site, a verified company 50. Docs: https://alion.io/developers/docs

conversation_id.description: To continue a conversation you have: its id and message only.

idempotency_key.description: Your key for this message: a repeat with the same key answers the first outcome.

job.description: The offer, as the person will read it.

countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes of where the work is (or may be done from).

pay.description: The pay range. Required for a job offer: it is checked against the person's floor.

role.description: Role family or specialisation ("Backend", "Data Engineer"); the title is read when it is left out.

url.description: The vacancy page: an alion.io/job/... link or the company's own job board.

message.description: 30-2000 characters. Contacts are never asked in a first message.

on_behalf_of.description: Who the message is from. A company named must be the one your agent verified (verify_company).

name.description: The person the candidate would talk to.

person.description: The person: their Alion handle (the "person" field of a search row), or an alion.io/user/<handle> or alion.io/@<handle> link.

purpose.description: Why you write; job_offer (the default) needs job with its pay.

reply_by.description: ISO date the offer waits for an answer until (default 14 days, at most 60).

why_this_person.description: One or two sentences: a fact of the profile (a skill, an employer, a project, a school) and why it matters for this offer.

name: send_message

kind.description: reply or reminder, for a continued conversation

meta.description: Quota and credit standing after this call.

billing.description: live (charged), free_daily (a compact read of the daily allowance), preview (metered, not charged yet), staff, partner or free

credits_left.description: The account balance after this call, in credits.

free_reads_left_today.description: Compact reads still free today for an assistant connected through OAuth (Claude, ChatGPT)

tier.description: anonymous, free, pro, partner or staff

title: Write to a person
